items.summary: Injection-class vulnerability (CWE-74) in Cisco's Unified Communications family — Emergency Responder, Unified CM, Unity Connection and others — network-reachable without authentication. Part of Cisco's October 21 hardening release; fixed in 15SU5, no workarounds.

Improper-authentication vulnerability (CWE-287) across Cisco's Unified Communications products, exploitable remotely without credentials. Disclosed in Cisco's October 21 security hardening release alongside 7 other grouped CVEs; fixed in 15SU5, no workarounds.

Cross-site scripting vulnerability class (CWE-79) in Cisco Unified Communications products scoring 9.3. Found by Cisco's internal testing (aided by frontier AI models) and patched in the October 21 hardening release; fixed in 15SU5, no workarounds.

One of the two 'PHP2Shell' critical flaws: remote code execution via out-of-memory corruption in the PHP runtime itself (session upload progress handler), reachable on arbitrary endpoints before app code runs. Fixed Oct 21 in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35; 8.1 and older get no official patch.

The second 'PHP2Shell' critical flaw: remote code execution via stale global state after a fatal error, affecting PHP-FPM and mod_php alike, with a public PoC already circulating. Emergency Oct 21 releases fix it on supported branches; set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 as a partial mitigation if you can't patch yet.
